goals.goal: Make ¼ of my meal carbs
standards: ¼ of the meal is starchy, carbohydrate foods. This does not include dairy, fruits, or vegetables.
½ of the grains in the meal will be whole grains.

goals.goal: Make ½ of my meal fruits and/or vegetables
standards: The meal contains at least ½ cup of fruit and 1 cup of non-starchy vegetables.
At least 1 serving of whole fruits is present on the plate.
It is acceptable if the meal also contains juice.

goals.goal: Choose a variety of fruits and vegetables
standards: At least 2 different types of fruit or vegetable are present with the meal.
No fried potatoes are included.
Baked, roasted, or boiled potatoes are acceptable.

goals.goal: Make ¼ of my meal protein
standards: ¼ of the plate is protein.
The main protein of the meal must be lean. For example, a turkey sandwich with a slice or two of bacon versus a BLT.
At least 1 serving of plant protein is present in the meal.
No fried foods.
No high fat dairy.
No high fat meats.
No more than 1 tablespoon of butter, 2 tablespoons of salad dressing, or 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise.

goals.goal: Choose vegetable fats and oils over solid fats
standards: No more than 1 tablespoon of solid fats, such as butter or lard, is used in the meal.

goals.goal: Choose a meal without added sugar
standards: The meal will not include foods that are known to contain added sugar.
These foods include pastries, cookies, candies, cakes, and regular sodas.
100% fruit juice is acceptable.
Water is shown with the meal or the user writes water in the description of the meal.

goals.goal: Drink water instead of sugary beverages
standards: No sugary beverages are shown with the meal or described in the description of the meal.

goals.goal: Reduce the portion size of my meal
standards: Carbohydrates take up ¼ of the plate.
Protein takes up ¼ of the plate.
Vegetables and fruit make up ½ of the plate.
